title: Profitable pharmacy software vendor, price down on a cloud transition

input.facts: Pharmacy management software sold by subscription with maintenance; recurring revenue is 78% of sales and customer churn is under 3%. The share price fell 30% after a migration of the customer base to the cloud product temporarily depressed license revenue; management expects the transition to complete next year. No holder above 25%. No regulatory issue.

why: In-segment, recurring revenue above 50%, temporary price drop, leverage far below 4x, no flag, no kill criterion: Priority.
